_comment: Why each unshipped Vega provider stays out. Keyed by the id in docs/vega-triage.json. `family` groups providers behind the same gate so a future round does not re-probe them one by one; `checked` is the date the evidence was last confirmed.

1cinevood.reason: one.cinevood.business does not resolve; the mirrors printed on the old home page are dead too

skyMovieHD.reason: the mirror now only redirects to skybap.site, a 5 KB placeholder

eonMovies.reason: post pages answer 90-117 KB but expose no stream host; the player is built client-side

movielinkdb.reason: post pages carry only download instructions; the file list is injected

katMovieFix.reason: hubcloud.ink /drive/ pages return 46 KB of whitespace, links injected after load

extraflix.reason: post -> linkshub.fun/view -> Turnstile; the destination is a drivehub.dad mirror-on-demand page, not a file

world4u.reason: post -> w4links.cfd -> fastilinks.beauty -> captcha (6 challenges on the page)

topmovies.reason: moviesleech -> leechpro -> thenaukriadda shortlink chain, unsolved

Joya9tv.reason: post pages expose .mkv names but every download goes through a shortlink

katmovies.reason: katmoviehd mirrors ship config only; the actual link layer is a shortlink

cinefreak.reason: post -> cinecloud.top/f/<token>, whose download needs Google OAuth; /fastdl/<id> 404s without it

mkvDrama.reason: cf_clearance cookie required before any post page answers

rareanimes.reason: posts answer 400 KB but the player needs a site session

netflixMirror.reason: needs an app-session token from a mobile build

primeMirror.reason: needs an app-session token from a mobile build

disneyMirror.reason: needs an app-session token from a mobile build

showbox.reason: app bundle scraping only; the web surface has no catalogue

movieBoxWeb.reason: the web wrapper requires a signed app session

kartoons.reason: device login before the catalogue opens

tokyoInsider.reason: Cloudflare challenge; the old endpoints are gone

ridoMovies.reason: 403 on the API from a residential IP

moviesApi.reason: vidspark.to is a JS app; the cipher needs the running bundle

moviezwap.reason: download pages render the file list client-side

1flex.reason: altcha proof-of-work plus a WASM solver

ringz.reason: the API host no longer answers

flixhq.reason: no public Consumet instance serves it

hiAnime.reason: no public Consumet instance serves it

dooflix.reason: no base URL left in the manifest

animesaltravok.reason: the ravok.buzz player path is gone
